These products work—not in the allopathic "pharma-medicine" way, but in a terrain-support, consciousness bolstering plant-teacher sort of way.

recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.
recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Name: The Sonic Slider

I use LotusWei Elixirs to give me an edge with psychic & energetic sensitivity, discernment, and life force coherence. recMVdJjP2VZJyI2m.Body: Clive de Carle has spent decades researching high-quality natural health essentials, from magnesium and fulvic minerals to iodine, selenium, and vegan-sourced vitamin D. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Where Biofield Tuning Meets Biomagnetism", "body": "Austin Walters traces biomagnetism to Mexican physician Isaac Goiz, who he says heard a NASA physician describe astronauts returning with one leg shorter and began pairing north and south magnets. In Austin's account, a practitioner reads a quarter inch leg length shift to locate an imbalance and leaves pairs in place for about fifteen minutes so the body can restore its own pH. Eileen McKusick, citing Jerry Tennant's Healing Is Voltage, translates every mention of pH into voltage and urges listeners to think electrically. Since, as she puts it, magnetic fields guide electric currents, she sees a vibrating fork and a static magnet doing the same job."}, {"title": "The Biofield as a Banded Torus", "body": "Eileen describes the biofield as a plasma bubble and torus, drawing positive charge from the sky and negative charge from the earth up a central channel she compares to the Ida and Pingala. In a meditative vision, she says, she saw it divided into twelve bands of twelve strands each, 144 strands of light. Chance adds what he calls the holes of the donut, the terminal points above the head and below the feet, and describes finding them pulled in front of clients who feel stuck, which Eileen calls the heart shield. He then leads listeners through a live adjustment of those points."}, {"title": "Emotion and Resonance Over Germs, in Their View", "body": "Asked by Chance whether he addresses the why behind an injury, Austin describes illness as an iceberg with emotion at its base, saying his mentor Dr. Luis Garcia would likely agree it is roughly half emotion and half microbes, and that he muscle tests for an emotion tied to each pathogen he finds. Eileen, who says she is just not convinced microbes are what is infectious, offers resonance instead, comparing shared illness to a yawn spreading without any yawn particles. Chance brings in Matt Powers's work on bacteria that shift form and argues that changing the vibe we hold may change the microbiome itself."}, {"title": "Remote Sessions and the Question of Distance", "body": "Austin says about 98 percent of his biomagnetism clients are remote, worked through an inanimate surrogate while he visualizes the pairs and sends the energy, and he leaves open whether results come from the client's belief or from an energy exchange. Chance tells clients that the first tone is an experiential lesson that separation and distance are mental concepts, then asks both guests how they picture plasma. Eileen answers that vibration moving through the ether separates charge through torsion, spinning it into plasma and then into denser and denser spun light. So in a distance session, she says, nothing travels; it is just resonating."}, {"title": "Psychic Vampirism, Hexes and Shielding the Field", "body": "The talk turns to energetic protection after co-host Gabriel describes a capoeira master who, he believes, hexed his knees. Chance calls that the mark of a deliberate energy vampire and offers his own theory: babies must draw on their parents' fields until about six or seven, so most vampirism is an unconscious survival habit carried from childhood. Eileen describes filling the double layer membrane of her field with milk that only her husband and kids may pass, plus a wall of roses for group sessions, while Austin pictures silvery pillars and a shimmering bubble before remote work. Chance adds that rehearsing arguments with absent people intrudes on their space."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Two of the most practical electric health modalities meet for the first time. Eileen McKusick developed biofield tuning, mapping the human energy field with tuning forks and clearing stuck charge through sound. Austin Walters teaches biomagnetism, restoring physiological pH balance using pairs of North and South pole magnets to eliminate the conditions pathogens need to survive. Different tools, same underlying physics.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: Topics: the origin of biomagnetism through Dr. Isaac Goiz and a NASA physician noticing leg length discrepancy in astronauts; how the leg length reflex works as a diagnostic tool for pH imbalance; the heart shield, what it means when someone's magnetic field is projecting in front of them; the nocebo effect and why belief may be the most powerful variable in any healing modality; why "bio-field" literally contains the word for two snakes and maps directly to the caduceus; terminal points and the holes of the donut in the toroidal field; why Eileen kept breaking tuning forks while writing her second book; remote healing as experiential proof that distance and separation are mental constructs; and psychic vampirism, why it exists, where it comes from developmentally, and how to protect your field.
